name: collect_review_comments
description: Review analytics, step 1: read the review comments of pull requests from Bitbucket into Orwick's own store (~/.orwick/analytics), with the code each was written on and the replies. Reads only pull requests changed since the last run. Give repos the first time (remembered afterwards); it changes no project and posts nothing.

repos.description: Repos to learn from, as workspace/repo or as folder names in the workspace or code root, e.g. ["acme/payments", "orders"]; empty: the ones chosen before

months.description: How many months back to read; give it only to read further back than before (default 6 the first time)
